title: Seasonal Service Terms, Prepayment Clause — Facility Charges Prepaid at an Electric Service by Rate Schedule Restore
content:
**Prepayment clause.** On the restore of an idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule account, facility charges are prepaid with the restore payment in the following cases. The facility charge is the schedule's monthly facility charge (Schedule RS $38.75, Schedule IR $54.00).

| Account record | Prepaid with the restore payment |
|---|---|
| Connected less than twelve whole months before the current date and carrying no seasonal restore fee yet — the first restore of a new service | One monthly facility charge |
| Outside that case, with a returned payment dated less than twelve whole months before the current date | 2 monthly facility charges |
| Any other account | Nothing |

The prepaid amount is added to the restore payment before that payment is rounded to the cent and held at no less than zero.

### Hypothetical cases

| Account | Prepaid |
|---|---|
| Schedule RS cabin connected 8 whole months ago, no restore fee on file | $38.75 |
| Schedule IR pivot connected 8 whole months ago, one restore fee already on file, a returned payment 3 months ago | 2 facility charges, $108.00 |
| Schedule IR pivot connected 6 years ago, no returned payment in the twelve months | Nothing |

### Point of reading

- The restore fees looked at are the seasonal restore fee lines ever billed on the same service account.
